blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Private Access > Private App Protection > AppProtection Policy.
In the table, locate the policy you want to modify and click the Edit icon.

blocks.text: If you only want to change an AppProtection policy rule's place in the Rule Order, you can manually enter in a new value on the AppProtection Policy page.

blocks.item: In the Edit Rule window, modify fields as necessary. For more information about each field, see Configuring AppProtection Policies.

blocks.text: If you edit application segments that have Active Directory Inspection enabled, then a warning appears to notify you that the application segments and segment groups are inspected for Active Directory Protection traffic.
